+base = m.body('mobilebase0_base').id
+arm_joints = [m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}') for i in range(1, 8)]
+qadr = np.array([j.qposadr[0] for j in arm_joints])
+dadr = np.array([j.dofadr[0] for j in arm_joints])
+qlo = np.array([j.range[0] for j in arm_joints]) + 0.03
+qhi = np.array([j.range[1] for j in arm_joints]) - 0.03
+tmp = mujoco.MjData(m)
+R0 = s.data.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3).copy()
+
+
+def eef():
+    return s.data.site_xpos[site].copy()
+
+
+def objpos(name):
+    return s.data.xpos[m.body(name + '_main').id].copy()
+
+
+def joints():
+    return s.data.qpos[qadr].copy()
+
+
+def action(q=None, grip=-1, basecmd=None, torso=0, mode=-1):
+    a = np.zeros(13)
+    a[:7] = joints() if q is None else q
+    a[7] = grip
+    if basecmd is not None:
+        a[8:11] = basecmd
+    a[11] = torso
+    a[12] = mode
+    return a
+
+
+def step(a, n=1):
+    for _ in range(n):
+        s.step(a)
+
+
+def ik(p, R=R0, seed=None):
+    q = np.clip(joints() if seed is None else seed.copy(), qlo, qhi)
+    tmp.qpos[:] = s.data.qpos
+    jacp = np.zeros((3, m.nv)); jacr = np.zeros((3, m.nv))
+    for _ in range(100):
+        tmp.qpos[qadr] = q
+        mujoco.mj_forward(m, tmp)
+        pos = tmp.site_xpos[site]
+        ori = tmp.site_xmat[site].reshape(3, 3)
+        ep = p - pos
+        er = Rotation.from_matrix(R @ ori.T).as_rotvec()
+        if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.001 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.015:
+            break
+        mujoco.mj_jacSite(m, tmp, jacp, jacr, site)
+        J = np.vstack((jacp[:, dadr], 0.35*jacr[:, dadr]))
+        e = np.r_[ep, 0.35*er]
+        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + 0.003**2*np.eye(6), e)
+        dq = np.clip(dq, -0.12, 0.12)
+        q = np.clip(q + dq, qlo, qhi)
+    return q, np.linalg.norm(ep), np.linalg.norm(er)
+
+
+def move(p, grip=-1, R=R0, timeout=90, tol=0.012):
+    p = np.asarray(p, float)
+    q, ie, re = ik(p, R)
+    print('move target', p.round(3), 'IK error', round(ie,3), round(re,3), flush=True)
+    a = action(q, grip)
+    stable = 0
+    for i in range(timeout):
+        s.step(a)
+        dist = np.linalg.norm(eef()-p)
+        if dist < tol:
+            stable += 1
+            if stable >= 4: break
+        else: stable = 0
+    print('move done',i+1,'eef',eef().round(3),'dist',round(dist,3),'obj', {n:objpos(n).round(3).tolist() for n in ('chicken','shrimp','beef')},flush=True)

+
+

+
+

+    print('grasp',name,p,flush=True)

+
